newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 20.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Nov. 20:
WASHINGTON - A District company lost nearly half its value on the stock market after a government panel said it didn't deserve a special license to offer a new pay-radio service.
WASHINGTON - Triad International Maintenance Co., or Timco, will pay $140,000 to settle charges that it allowed racial discrimination and sexual harassment as its North Carolina facilities.
WASHINGTON - Two of the largest health care systems in the Washington area have joined forces to form a company offering management and consulting services to home health agencies.
WASHINGTON - A local mutual fund company specializing in "socially responsible" investing wants shareholders to shun tobacco stocks just as they once shunned companies active in South Africa.
